results.title: Ya dace sauye sauyen Najeriya su shafi jama'a kai tsaye - Amina Mohammed
results.content: Mataimakiyar Sakatare Janar na Majalisar Ɗinkin Duniya Amina Mohammed ta yaba da sabbin sauye sauyen da gwamnatin Bola Tinubu ke aiwatar wa, yayin da ta buƙaci ci gaba da aiwatar da su tare da neman ganin an inganta su ta yadda za su amfani jama'a

results.title: Kurdawa na samun nasara a kan mayakan ISIS a Syria
results.content: Dubban yan gudun hijira na ci gaba da tserewa fadan da ake tabkawa tsakanin Kurdawa da mayakan Jihadin kungiyar Isis a kasar Syriya al'amarin da ya haifar da kwararar 'yan gudun hijira a kasar Turkiya.

results.title: An samu raguwar kona motoci a bikin sabuwar shekara a Faransa
results.content: Gwamnatin Faransa tace an samu raguwar yawan adadin motocin da ake konewa a lokacin bikin sabuwar shekara da kashi 12 cikin 100 a cikin kasar. alkalumma sun nuna cewa a jajibirin sabuwar shekara an kone motoci 940 sabanin 1,067, da aka cinna wa wuta a shekarar da ta gabata.

results.title: Amnesty ta yi Allah wadai da kisan Shiek Yahaya Masussuka da ƴanbindiga suka yi
results.content: Ƙungiyar Amnesty International ta yi Allah wadai da kisan shahararren malamin addinin Musulunci a Najeriya, Shiek Yahaya Masussuka.

results.title: Kotun Duniya ta bukaci Afirka ta Kudu ta cafke El-Bashir
results.content: Kotun hukunta manyan laifufuka a duniya ICC ko kuma CPI ta bukaci hukumomin kasar Afirka ta kudu da su kama shugaban Sudan Umar Hasan El-bashir wanda ke halarar taron shugabannin Afirka yanzu haka a birnin Johannesburg.

results.title: An cafke mutane da dama kan zargin juyin mulki a Gambia
results.content: An cafke mutane da dama, da ake zargi suna da hannu a yunkurin jurin juyin mulkin da aka yi a kasar Gambia, lokacin da shugaban kasa Yahya Jammeh ke ziyara a birnin Dubai, wanda kuma ya dora alhakin harin kan ‘yan kasashen waje da bai bayyana sunayen su ba.

results.title: Rikicin addini ya yi sanadin mutuwar mutum 40 a Habasha
results.content: Akalla mutane sama da 40 aka kashe a wani ƙazamin harin da aka kan wata mujami’a da gidajen jama’a a yankin Oromia dake kasar Habasha a ƙarshen makon da ya gabata.

results.title: Ambaliyar Ruwan sama ta yi sanadiyar mutuwar mutane 12 a Jojiya
results.content: yanzu haka dai masu kula da namun daji na ci gaba da farautar namun daji a tsakkiyar birnin Tbilissi na kasar Jojiya, bayan da ambaliyar Ruwan sama da aka sheka a birnin ta rusa gidan namun dajin da a halin yanzu suka fantsama a cikin gari

results.title: Ana ci gaba da aikin neman tarkacen jirgin AirAsia
results.content: Yau Juma’a masu aiki neman sassan jirgin saman da ya yi hadari a kan tekun Java na kasar Indonesia, sun ci gaba da aikin, kuma suna gab da kaiwa inda lamarin ya faru. An dakatar da aikin neman Jirgin ne saboda matsalar Yanayi a tekun Indonesia

results.title: Martanin shugabannin duniya kan sake zaɓen Lula da Silva a wa'adi na huɗu
results.content: Shugabannin duniya na ci gaba da aikewa Lula da Silva saƙonnin taya murna bayan nasarar da ya samu a zaɓen shugaban ƙasar da ya gudana a Brazil don fara wa’adi na huɗu na jagorancin ƙasar.

results.title: Taron Kungiyar Tarayyar Afirka karo na 25
results.content: A yau lahadi ake buda taron shugabannin kasashen kungiyar Tarayyar Afirka karo na 25 a birnin Jonnesburg na kasar Afirka ta Kudu, taron da zai mayar da hankali kan batutuwa da dama da suka shafi kasashen nahiyar.

results.title: Jami’an Italiya sun yi kokarin ceto jirgin ruwan Bakin haure
results.content: Jami’an kula da jiragen ruwa a kasar Italiya sun nasarar ceto wani jirgin ruwa da ya samu matsala a tsakiyar teku shake da bakin haure kimanin 450 bayan sun yi nasarar ceto rayuwan bakin haure da dama a cikin kwanaki biyu da suka gabata.

results.title: Shugaba Alexander na Serbia ya amince da shan kayi a zaɓen ƴan majalisar ƙasar
results.content: Tsohon shugaban Serbia, Alexander Vucic, ya amince da shan kaye a zaɓen ƴan majalisar dokoki da aka gudanar ranar lahadi.

results.title: Kotu ba ta amince da tsige shugaba Rajoanarimampianina ba
results.content: Kotun kolin kasar Madagascar ta yi watsi da matakin tsige shugaban kasar Hery Rajoana-rimampianina da majalisar dokokin kasar ta yi a ranar 26 ga watan jiya.

results.title: An sake zabar Netanyahu a matsayin shugaban Jam’iyya mai mulki
results.content: An sake zabar Fraiministan kasar Isra’ila Benjamin Netanyahu, a matsayin shugaban jam’iyyar Likud mai mulkin kasar, a wani zaben fitar da gwanin da aka yi jiya Alhamis. Zaben na zuwa ne a daidai lokacin da ake shirin yin wani zaben gaggawa a kasar, inda ya kayar da abokin takarar shi Danny Danon mai ra’ayin gurguzu.

results.title: Dalilan da ya sa gwamnatin Tinubu ke yi wa ƴan adawa bita da ƙulli
results.content: Hukumar Da’ar ma’aikata a Najeriya ta kaddamar da bincike kan wasu fitattun yan siyasa bakwai a kasar da suka hada da tsohon gwamnan jihar Anambra Peter Obi da tsoffin shugabannin majalissar Dattijai Bukola Saraki da David Mark sai marigayi gwamnan jihar Bayelsa Diepreye Alamieyeseigha. Sauran sun hada da Tsohuwar ministan sufurin jiragen sama Stella Oduah da Stella Ogene tsohuwar ma’aikaciyar shari’a a jihar Delta.

results.title: Sarkozy ya soki kawance da ke fada da mayakan IS
results.content: Tsohon shugaban Faransa Nicolas Sarkozy ya yi kakkausar ga kawancen dakarun kasashen duniya a karkashin jagorancin Amurka, dangane da yadda ya kasa murkushe mayakan da ke da’awar jihadi a kasashen Syria da Iraki.

results.title: NCDC na nazarin baiwa kowanne mutum da aka killace saboda Ebola Naira dubu 100
results.content: Hukumar yaƙi da cututtuka ta NCDC a Najeriya ta bayyana cewar tana tunanin bada Naira dubu 100 a kowanne mako ga dukkan mutanen da ta killace don hana yaduwar cutar Ebola. NCDC ta ce ta yi tunanin yin hakan ne don rage damuwa ga mutane biyo bayan ƙorafe-ƙorafen wadanda aka killace ke yi.

results.title: Hillary na gudanar da yakin neman zaben shugabancin Amurka
results.content: Tsohuwar sakatariyar harkokin wajen Amurka Hillary Clinton ta kaddamar da yakin neman zabenta na neman tsayawa takarar shugabancin Amurka a jiya asabar, inda ta ce tana fatar kasancewar mace ta farko da za ta jagoranci kasar a tarihi.

results.title: Shugaba Lula da Silva ya sake lashe zaɓen ƙasar Brazil a wa'adi na huɗu
results.content: Kotun ƙoli da ke kula da al’amuran zaɓen ƙasar Brazil, ta ayyana shugaban ƙasar Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva, a matsayin wanda ya lashe zaɓen ƙasar da aka gudanar a wa'adi na huɗu, bayan da ya kayar da Sanata Flavio Bolsonaro, babban ɗan tsohon shugaban ƙasar Jair Bolsonaro, wanda yazo na ɗaya a zagaye na farko na zaɓen.

results.title: RFI Hausa zai sauya Shafinsa na Intanet
results.content: Daga 15 ga watan Yuni, hausa.rfi.fr, shafin Intanet na RFI Hausa zai sauya sabuwar fuska, mai bayar da muhimmanci kan salon yada labarai irin na rediyo da hotunan bidiyo.

results.title: An gano gawarwakin mutum 54 da ƴanbindiga suka kashe a arewacin Mali
results.content: Rundunar sojin Mali ta sanar da gano gawarwakin mutane 54 a ƙauyen Tagadayat da ke tazarar kilomita 35 a kudu maso gabashin Menaka bayan wasu jerin hare hare kan fararen hula da mayaƙa masu ikirarin jihadi suka kai yankin.

results.title: Uganda za ta fara killace ƴan kasarta da suka ziyarci DR Congo saboda Ebola
results.content: Ministan Lafiyan ƙasar Uganda, Chris Baryomunsi, ya bayyana a ranar Lahadi cewa, za a killace 'yan ƙasar Uganda da ke dawowa gida bayan sun ziyarci Jamhuriyar Dimokuradiyyar Kongo, har na tsawon kwanaki 21. Wannan mataki dai da ƙasar ta ɗauka na zuwa ne yayin da Uganda ke ƙara tsaurara matakan kariya daga cutar Ebola.

results.title: Ƴan bindiga da ake zargin ƴan fashi ne sun kashe mutane da dama a Binnari
results.content: Adadin wadanda suka mutu sakamakon harin da 'yan bindiga dauke da makamai suka kai a wani gari da ke karkara a Najeriya ya karu zuwa 50, kamar yadda wadanda suka tsira bayan gano karin gawawwaki.

results.title: Fafaroma Leo ya yi kira a kawo ƙarshen rikicin Yemen
results.content: Fafaroma Leo na 14 ya yi kira da a kawo ƙarshen tashe-tashen hankula a Yemen, makwanni biyu bayan an yi masa tiyatar sankarar huhu.

results.title: Ibrahim Salissou kan tura sojojin Aljeriya zuwa Nijar da za a yi
results.content: Majalisun dokokin Aljeriya, sun bai wa gwamnati damar tura sojojin ƙasar zuwa Jamhuriyar Nijar, kwanaki uku bayan da ministocin ƙasashen biyu suka rattaba hannu kan yarjejeniyar tsaro a tsakaninsu. Aljeriya da Nijar ƙasashe ne da suka raba iyakar mai tsawon sama da kilomita 900, yayin da ake kallon yankin iyakar a matsayin wanda fatake ke amfani da shi domin gudanar da safara iri-iri.

results.title: Ya kamata ƴan adawa su daina sanya siyasa kan batun zuba jarin Dangote - Ruto
results.content: Shugaban Kenya William Ruto ya buƙaci ‘yan adawa da su daina sanya zuba hannun jarin da Aliko Dangote ya yi a kamfanin shimfiɗa bututun mai na ƙasar cikin siyasa, yana mai cewa kuskukure ne muzanta masu zuba jarin maƙudan kuɗaɗensu a ƙasar ta Kenya.

results.title: Jagorar adawar Venezuela ta koma gida bayan watanni 18 na hijira
results.content: Jagorar adawar Venezuela, Maria Corina Machado, ta koma gida a wannan Lahadin da ta gabata bayan shafe watanni 10 tana gudun hijira.

results.title: Ƴan wasan 3 da ke kan gaba wajen lashe kyautar Ballon d'Or ta bana
results.content: A yau ne za a gudanar da bikin bada kyautar Ballon d'Or, karo na 70 wacce za ta gudana a birnin London na ƙasar Ingila. Kawo yanzu dai ƴan wasa uku ne ke kan gaba wajen lashe kyautar a bana, waɗanda suka haɗa da kyatin ɗin tawagar Ingila Harry Kane da takwaransa na Faransa Kylian Mbappe sai kuma Lamine Yamal na Andalus.

results.title: Sharhi kan yadda ta kaya a wasan El-Clasico da aka yi a ƙarshen mako
results.content: Shirin Duniyar Wasanni a wannan mako ya maida hankali kan wasan El-Clasico da aka yi tsakanin Barcelona da Real Madrid. Shi dai wasa tsakanin waɗannan ƙungiyoyi ba wai wasa bane na gama gari, domin yanada ɗinbin tarihi ganin cewa an faro shine a shekarar 1902, kuma wancan lokacin Barcelona ce ta fara samun nasara kan Madrid da ci 3-1. Sai dai a wasan na daren jiya Lahadi Madrid ce ta samu nasara da ci 2-1.
